DMS_ProcessDocumentQuest.questDescriptio.li:
questDescription->[asker_nameFull], an adjutant of the Colonial Fleet, has forwarded us a batch of backlogged paperwork for processing. Their clerical division is [docReason], and the overflow is being contracted out to frontier settlements. The batch consists mostly of [docContents].

If we accept, the documents will arrive by drop pod near our trade beacons or colony center. Personnel with suitable research capabilities must verify and file each one.

[asker_nameDef] was explicit about one condition: the fleet expects every document back intact. If any document is destroyed, the contract ends immediately. Payment will follow once the entire batch is processed.
docReason->short-handed after the latest personnel rotation
docReason->months behind following an archive system failure
docReason->buried under a season's worth of frontline reporting
docReason->scrambling to close the books before a fleet audit
docContents->supply manifests, ammunition expenditure records and drone maintenance logs
docContents->casualty notices and after-action reports, some still smelling of gun smoke
docContents->classified files we are expected to process without reading
docContents->requisition forms, repair orders and letters that were never sent
